Rule: Circular 121/2020/TT-BTC, Article 24 (client information for investment advice)
Design response: Ensa records goal, horizon, income and loss tolerance; a licensed adviser designs and signs the model plans; advice is logged

Requirement: No investing on a client's behalf without a mandate
Design response: The customer confirms the plan and every change; the system only invests new money as the confirmed plan says

Requirement: Lending only for margin and defined purposes
Design response: No credit line on savings; margin is not a reward

Requirement: Portfolio management is not a securities-company business
Design response: No discretionary service; a fully managed version only through a licensed fund manager

Rule: Circular 64/2024/TT-NHNN: banks must comply by 1 March 2027; customer consent lasts at most 180 days
Design response: Phase 1 uses standing orders the customer sets in the bank app; salary-linked percentage contributions only after bank agreements (Phase 3)

Rule: Decision 461/QD-XPHC (17 August 2026): VND 275 million of the VND 802.5 million fine was for services not reported to the SSC
Design response: Notify the SSC before launch; written confirmation is a Gate 0 condition

Rule: New Golden Egg openings were paused at the regulator's request from 25 December 2023 (DNSE notice)
Design response: Pre-consult the SSC on Golden Egg's role in Payday; keep bond funds ready as the alternative core

Rule: DNSE registered as a fund-certificate distribution agent (15 December 2021) but is not on the distributor lists of SSIAM, Dragon Capital or VCBF
Design response: Sign distribution agreements with 1 to 2 managers in Phase 0; launch with Golden Egg and an ETF if they are late
